Set up **{name}**?

On the next screen you will complete pairing. Hold the button until pairing finishes and stay near your ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.
bluetooth_confirm.title: Discovered Flic device

pair.description:
Pair with **{name}**:

1. Make sure the LED is **flashing** (pairing mode). Hold the button for **7 seconds** if needed.
2. Select **Submit** below.
3. **Keep holding** the button until pairing finishes.

Stay near your ESPHome Bluetooth proxy during pairing.
pair.title: Pair with Flic device

user.description:
Before you continue:

1. **Factory-reset** the button if it was ever used with the Flic app or flicd (hold ~15 seconds until the LED flashes rapidly).
2. Put the button in **pairing mode** — hold for **7 seconds** until the LED flashes slowly.
3. Stand within range of your **ESPHome Bluetooth proxy** (or local Bluetooth adapter).

When you select **Submit**, Home Assistant will listen for the button. **Keep holding** the button until it is found (up to {timeout} seconds).
user.title: Prepare your Flic button
